name: communication
description: Reach people — Slack, WhatsApp (wacli), and iMessage, each on its own dedicated host behind Cloudflare Access. Supply the per-server Cloudflare Access service-token credentials to enable.

SLACK_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.title: Slack — CF Access Client ID
SLACK_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.description: CF-Access-Client-Id for slack.loup-peluso.com (per-MCP service token; ends in .access).

SLACK_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Slack — CF Access Client Secret
SLACK_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: CF-Access-Client-Secret for slack.loup-peluso.com. Stored in the system keychain; maintainer copy SOPS-encrypted in secrets/cloudflare-access.sops.json.
